020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.Phase;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
023import org.bukkit.Location;
024import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
025import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
026
027/**
028 * Represents an event when a new shop is created. This event is triggered when a new shop is
029 * created with associated user information.
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.2.0.9
033 */
034public class ShopCreateEvent extends ShopEvent {
035
036
037  protected final QUser user;
038  protected final Location location;
039
040  public ShopCreateEvent(final @Nullable Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user, final @NotNull Location location) {
041
042    super(shop);
043
044    this.user = user;
045    this.location = location;
046  }
047
048  public ShopCreateEvent(final Phase phase, final @Nullable Shop shop, final @NotNull QUser user, final @NotNull Location location) {
049
050    super(phase, shop);
051
052    this.user = user;
053    this.location = location;
054  }
055
056  public QUser user() {
057
058    return user;
059  }
060
061  public Location location() {
062
063    return location;
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Creates a new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase.
068   *
069   * @param newPhase The new Phase for the cloned PhasedEvent
070   *
071   * @return A new instance of PhasedEvent with the specified newPhase
072   */
073  @Override
074  public ShopCreateEvent clone(final Phase newPhase) {
075
076    return new ShopCreateEvent(newPhase, this.shop, this.user, this.location);
077  }
078}
